name: Full body, 2 days
description: Two whole body sessions a week, Full body A and Full body B, with at least two rest days between them. It suits people who are new to lifting or have little time.

name: Full body, 3 days
description: Three whole body sessions a week on alternate days, using Full body A and Full body B.

name: Dumbbells at home, 3 days
description: Three whole body sessions a week for a home gym with dumbbells and a bench. It alternates Full body dumbbell and Full body dumbbell B.

name: Upper and lower, 4 days
description: Four sessions a week that alternate upper body and lower body days, with a rest day after each pair. It uses Upper body A and B and Lower body A and B.

name: Push, pull, legs, 3 days
description: One push day, one pull day and one leg day a week on alternate days. Each muscle group is trained once a week.

name: Push, pull, legs, 6 days
description: Push, pull and leg days run twice a week with one rest day. It has a high weekly workload and suits people who already train regularly.

name: Strength 5x5, 3 days
description: Three barbell sessions a week that alternate Strength 5x5 A and B, mostly sets of five on the main lifts.

name: Bodybuilding split, 5 days
description: A five day split with a chest day, a back day, a leg day, a shoulders and arms day and a second lower body day. It has a rest day after the first three sessions.

name: Push, pull, legs, upper, lower, 5 days
description: Push, pull and leg days early in the week, then an upper body day and a lower body day. It has a rest day in the middle and at the end.

name: Low volume, 3 days
description: Three short barbell sessions a week with one or two hard sets per exercise and long rests. It is for experienced lifters who recover well between sessions.

name: Calisthenics, 3 days
description: Three bodyweight sessions a week that need only a pull-up bar and floor space. They cover pulling and core, pushing and legs, and the whole body.

name: Kettlebell, 3 days
description: Three whole body sessions a week with one kettlebell, alternating Kettlebell full body and Kettlebell full body B. Use a weight that suits each movement.

name: Push and pull, 4 days
description: Four sessions a week that alternate push days and pull days, with a rest day after each pair. It uses Push day and Push day B, and Pull day and Pull day B.

name: Glute focus, 4 days
description: Four sessions a week that pair two glute focused lower body days with two upper body days. It uses Glute focus and Glute focus B, and Upper body A and B.

name: Bodyweight, 3 days
description: Three beginner sessions a week that need no equipment, alternating Bodyweight full body and Bodyweight full body B. There is no pulling exercise, so it does not replace rows or pull-ups.

name: Resistance band, 3 days
description: Three beginner whole body sessions a week with a resistance band, alternating Resistance band full body and Resistance band full body B. The band rows, pulldowns and face pulls cover pulling.

name: Hotel room, 2 days
description: Two short sessions a week for travel that need only floor space, Hotel room starter and Bodyweight full body. There is no pulling exercise, so it does not replace rows or pull-ups.
